The '''Shipwright's Tools''' was a relic of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] kept at the [[Tarlam]] City Archives. The tools were significant because they were made by the first colonists who settled on the planet from the material dismantled from their ships. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]], archivist [[Varus]] attempted to save the tools from the mercenary-ridden archives before departing the planet on [[the Ark]].
